comment: The text identifies product, facility, and provider as the three supply-chain master-data pillars but conflates provider data with the Health Workforce Registry. Suppliers, organisations, contracts, and logistics locations are also needed.

anchor.note: p.127 l.Lines 156-160 read as the printed page; section 4 agrees

public.text: The text identifies product, facility, and provider as the three supply-chain master-data pillars but conflates provider data with the Health Workforce Registry. Suppliers, organisations, contracts, and logistics locations are also needed.
public.suggestedRevision: Describe the relevant master-data domains more precisely and distinguish practitioner, facility, organisation, supplier, product, and location identities.
